# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 and new APIs** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates to Skia m150 and expands image filtering, overdraw visualization, and paint bounds APIs. The release also improves small-sigma raster blurs, reuses the SKSurface canvas wrapper, and refreshes bundled HarfBuzz. Pre-v4 obsolete APIs now produce compile errors, so review the migration guidance before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Pre-v4 obsolete APIs now fail to compile** — APIs already marked obsolete before v4 are now compile errors, and obsolete enums are absent from the reference assembly. Replace affected calls using their existing obsolete migration guidance before upgrading. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m150** — Moves the bundled rendering engine to Chrome milestone 150 and includes a follow-up round that resolves a macOS typeface stream race and stabilizes Graphite static bindings. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **Image filter composition expanded** — Adds SKImageFilter.CreateCrop() and SKImageFilter.CreateEmpty() for explicit crop and empty-filter effects. ([#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228))
- **Overdraw visualization added** — Adds SKColorFilter.CreateOverdraw() for visualizing how often pixels are painted. ([#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227))
- **Fast paint bounds exposed** — Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds() to support inexpensive quick-reject culling. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small raster blurs restored** — Corrects a regression affecting small-sigma raster blur output. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **SKSurface canvas wrappers are reused** — Repeated Canvas access now returns the cached managed wrapper, reducing allocations while preserving the surface-owned canvas lifecycle. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## Platform

- **.NET Interactive support removed** — Drops the deprecated Polyglot Notebooks integration from the supported package surface. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Security

- **Bundled HarfBuzz refreshed** — Updates the bundled text-shaping dependency to HarfBuzz 14.2.1. ([#4167](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4167))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Refreshes the co-shipped HarfBuzzSharp package and bundled HarfBuzz dependency to 14.2.1.
